title: Python and REST APIs: Interacting With Web Services
description: Learn to consume web services with the requests library, then explore the tools for building a Python REST API of your own.
summary: There’s an amazing amount of data available on the Web. Many web services , like YouTube and GitHub, make their data accessible to third-party applications through an application programming interface (API) .
takeaways: Python provides some great tools not only to get data from REST APIs but also to build your own Python REST APIs.
